title: Building with Small Pieces
seo_title: Grade 2 Building with Small Pieces Worksheets: Take Apart and Build Again
standard_text: Make observations to construct an evidence-based account of how an object made of a small set of pieces can be disassembled and made into a new object.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on building with small pieces (NGSS 2-PS1-3): take objects apart, count the pieces and build something new. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Taking apart and rebuilding keeps the same pieces and weight.
body_html:
How to think about it

Take it apart. Build something new.

  • Big things are made of small pieces.
  • The same pieces can make a new shape.
  • The number of pieces stays the same.
Example

A wall has 10 blocks. You make a car with all of them. How many blocks?

Same pieces.

Answer: 10

Example

A tower weighs 100 g. You build a bridge with the same blocks. Weight?

Same pieces, same weight.

Answer: 100 g

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a taller or bigger shape has more blocks.
  • Thinking pieces disappear when you take something apart.
  • Thinking the new object weighs more or less.
